channel.title: While We Were There
channel.description: The family journal of Andrew, Michelle, Harrison, Sullivan, and Maeve. Real trips and close-to-home days from Toronto, with the films on YouTube.

item.title: Rome and Vatican City 3-Day Itinerary: Colosseum, Pantheon, Forum, and St. Peter's
item.description: Our Rome and Vatican City 3-day itinerary from an early fall trip: Colosseum, Trevi Fountain, Pantheon, Castel Sant'Angelo, Roman Forum, St. Peter's Square, and current booking rules.

item.title: Pompeii Day Trip from Sorrento: Forum Streets, Vesuvius, and What to Expect
item.description: Our Pompeii day trip from Sorrento in early fall: the Forum, paved streets under Vesuvius, the amphitheatre, vineyard, Small Theatre, plus current ticket rules and practical tips.

item.title: Sorrento and Amalfi Coast Itinerary: Positano and Capri in Four Days
item.description: How we based in Sorrento for four nights on an early fall trip: Marina Grande, a day in Positano, a boat trip around Capri's Faraglioni, and practical planning notes.

item.title: Florence 2-Day Itinerary: The Duomo, Santa Croce, and Walking the Arno
item.description: Our Florence 2-day itinerary from an early fall trip: walking up to the Duomo, San Lorenzo market, Santa Croce, Ponte Vecchio, and practical planning notes.

item.title: Paris 4-Day Itinerary: Rainy Walks, Versailles, and the Seine
item.description: Our 4-day Paris itinerary from an early fall trip: Bastille in the rain, Versailles, the Eiffel Tower after dark, the Louvre, Notre-Dame, and practical planning notes.

item.title: From Paris to Rome: An Early Fall Trip Overview
item.description: Michelle and I spent two weeks walking from a rainy first afternoon in Paris to Florence, the Amalfi Coast, Capri, Pompeii, and Rome—a route we can still follow stop by stop through our photographs.
